blocks.text: **The task.** Given a 2D matrix, answer repeated queries for the sum of a rectangular region defined by its top-left and bottom-right corners. The matrix never changes.
Reading the query as four corners
Every term is a rectangle anchored at the top-left of the matrix:

items: `prefix[r2+1][c2+1]` — everything from the origin to the bottom-right corner of our region.
`- prefix[r1][c2+1]` — remove the band above the region.
`- prefix[r2+1][c1]` — remove the band to the left.
`+ prefix[r1][c1]` — the top-left corner was inside both bands, so restore it once.

blocks.text: **Build: O(R x C)** time and space, once.
**Each query: O(1)** — four array reads and three arithmetic operations, regardless of region size.
Brute force would be O(R x C) per query. For a 1000 x 1000 matrix with 10,000 queries, that is ten billion operations versus one million for the build plus forty thousand for the queries.
